title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme Selection Examination
eligibility: Regular Class 8 students in government/government-aided/local-body schools in Madhya Pradesh
Class 7 result requirement and parental gross annual income ceiling apply as specified by the official record
Continuation requires specified marks in Classes 9-11
benefits: INR 12,000 per student per year after selection and National Scholarship Portal registration, as stated in the official record
documents_required: Documents required for examination and National Scholarship Portal registration
application_process: Apply online for the selection examination through the State Education Centre portal
Selected students register for scholarship on the National Scholarship Portal
important_sections_or_clauses: Scholarship is stated to continue for four years subject to the specified academic conditions.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
